title: What Is MCP? Give Your AI New Tools in 1 Minute
description:
What if your AI could use any tool you give it? 🔌

✅ MCP is like a USB port for your AI
✅ Servers are listed in a .mcp.json file with a name, a type and a url
✅ Run claude mcp list to see them connect

Day 4 of AI Dev Tools! Next up: Day 5, Add Your First MCP Server.
Follow for a new short every day and learn AI dev tools from scratch.
